title.narrative: Kigali HFC implementation plan (Stage I) in Tunisia

description.narrative: The Kigali HFC implementation plan (Stage I) is a strategic framework designed to support Tunisia in reducing its consumption of hyd rofluorocarbons (HFCs), potent greenhouse gases used in refrigeration and air conditioning. By adhering to the plan, Tunisia aims to achieve HFC reduction beyond 10% from its baseline consumption by January 1, 2029. This aligns with the Kigali Amendment's global goal of cutting down HFC use by 80% by 2045. The plan includes a variety of measures such as updating regulations, enhancing industry practices, and promoting the adoption of alternative technologies that are less harmful to the environment. Through these concerted efforts, Tunisia will not only meet its international obligations under the Kigali Amendment but also contribute to the global fight against climate change.
